goal: Iske baad aap coordinate grid par drawing ka plan bana sakenge aur plan ko graphics.h code mein badal sakenge: walls, roof, door, window, sun aur text.
warmup: Lahore mein mistri ghar banane se pehle seedha eentein lagana shuru nahi karta: architect measurements ke saath plan banata hai. Drawing program mein bhi yehi kaam karta hai. Agar aap pehle numbers kaghaz par likh lein (walls kahan se shuru hoti hain, roof ki choti kitni oonchi hai), to code aasaan ho jata hai, aur galtiyan dhoondna bhi aasaan.
definition: Drawing simple shapes se bani hoti hai jo coordinates se rakhi jati hain. Ghar ek rectangle (walls), do lines (roof), ek chhota rectangle (door), shayad ek circle (sun) aur kuch text se banta hai. Har shape ek function call hai, aur calls ki tarteeb hi drawing ki tarteeb hai. graphics.h standard C++ nahi hai. Yeh sirf lab PC par Turbo C++ (DOSBox) ya Code::Blocks/Dev-C++ ke saath WinBGIm library mein chalta hai, is liye page ka in-page compiler in programs ko nahi chala sakta. Is page ka canvas ek simulation hai jo woh draw karta hai jo wohi calls draw karti.
howItWorks: Step 1, plan: walls (200, 200) se (400, 350) tak ka rectangle hain. Step 2, roof: iski choti walls ke upar beech mein hai, x = (200 + 400) / 2 = 300 aur y = 120 par; do lines walls ke upar ke corners ko choti se jorti hain. Step 3, door: ek chhota rectangle jo 50 pixels chauri hai aur x = 300 par beech mein hai, to woh x = 275 se x = 325 tak aur y = 280 se neeche walls ke bottom y = 350 tak jata hai. Step 4, colour: setfillstyle phir floodfill, walls ke bilkul andar ke ek point ke saath. floodfill sirf us band region ko bharta hai jis mein woh point hai, is liye roof ka triangle (jo walls ke upar wale edge se band hota hai) khali rehta hai; use bhi rangna ho to roof ke andar ke point se floodfill dobara call karein, masalan (300, 160). Step 5: sun aur text. Yaad rakhein y neeche ki taraf barhta hai: roof ki choti ka y walls se CHHOTA hota hai. Pehla sample sirf planning ka hisaab aam console program ki tarah karta hai (yeh sach mein chalta hai). Do drawing samples Turbo C++ / WinBGIm ke liye hain aur canvas unhein simulate karta hai.
